a 7-day sample frequency is sufficient for compliance monitoring of atrazine in drinking water supplies in this area.

a 95% detection probability would be achieved by sampling every 7 days for the first quarter, every 3 days during the second quarter, and every 14 days for the remaining quarters of the year.

the monitoring program currently used for compliance monitoring may not be adequate to detect MCL exceedance of drinking water at a utility intake.
